phase: Argument of weighted mean complex phasor, not arithmetic mean of angles; common absolute timestamps and V1-aligned phase both retained.
amplitude: Coherent mean peak and mean of block peaks are separate. DC is signed in explicit columns.
variation: Unbiased weighted complex block scatter; indicator=2.3*scatter/sqrt(effective_blocks); effective_blocks=(sum weights)^2/sum(weights^2). Unknown for one block.
scope: Exploratory variation; not a certified confidence region, independence guarantee, discretization/seed error, or PSR proof.
power: Per-block signed products averaged with RF-duration weights; not product of mean phasors.
